causal_session_eligibility_specification.architecture_objective: Establish an ex-ante, causally valid definition of prospective defensive sessions that strictly prevents look-ahead bias and post-treatment outcome conditioning.

timeline_steps.name: Market Close (T-1)
timeline_steps.description: Trading session T-1 concludes. Cash close prices for all universe tickers are finalized.

timeline_steps.name: Vendor Bar Publication
timeline_steps.description: Vendor publishes finalized EOD bars with point-in-time dividend and split adjustments for session T-1. Arrival timestamp is cryptographically recorded.

timeline_steps.name: Regime Decision & Allocation (F_{T-1})
timeline_steps.description: Agent evaluates frozen strategy logic on market_state strictly restricted to bars <= T-1. State S_{T-1} (RISK_ON or DEFENSIVE) and target portfolio weights w_T are computed and immutably written to event journal.

timeline_steps.name: Order Decision & Deduplication
timeline_steps.description: Rebalance orders are calculated. Deterministic client order UUIDs (UUIDv5) are generated.

timeline_steps.name: Order Execution (T)
timeline_steps.description: Orders are submitted and executed at Market Open of session T (or simulated bar fill).

timeline_steps.name: Performance Observation Period
timeline_steps.description: Portfolio return R_{p,T} is realized over session T. Treatment allocation w_T is held fixed.

decision_time_information_model.information_boundary: Information set F_{T-1} contains zero observations, prices, volumes, returns, or corporate actions from session T or beyond.

causal_defensive_eligibility_definition.pre_execution_invariance: Session T eligibility is recorded in the immutable audit journal before session T market open (09:30 EST). It is completely independent of what happens during session T.

refutation_of_ex_post_conditioning.flawed_historical_definition: Defining defensive sessions as sessions where same-day market return R_{m,T} < 0 OR D2 enters cash.

causal_critique.post_treatment_conditioning: R_{m,T} is realized at 16:00 EST on day T. Conditioning on R_{m,T} < 0 selects observations based on the downstream outcome of the holding period.
causal_critique.collider_bias_and_drag_censorship: When S_{T-1} triggers DEFENSIVE but the market rallies on day T (R_{m,T} > 0), D2 suffers cash drag. Discarding these days because R_{m,T} >= 0 artificially censors false-alarm insurance costs, creating a severe positive selection bias.
causal_critique.governance_classification: Conditioning on R_{m,T} < 0 is formally classified as a SECONDARY DESCRIPTIVE SUB-ANALYSIS, NOT the primary causal evaluation.

bias_prevention_safeguards.look_ahead_bias: Enforced by strict timestamp ordering: regime calculation reads only bars with date <= T-1.
bias_prevention_safeguards.survivorship_bias: Universe membership is frozen in universe.json; point-in-time ticker availability is verified.
bias_prevention_safeguards.corporate_actions_look_ahead: Split and dividend adjustments apply strictly as of ex-date; future unannounced splits are excluded.
bias_prevention_safeguards.episode_alignment: Both E0 and D2 are evaluated on the exact same session calendar with identical execution timestamps.
